column5: single-token args need no braces: \frac12 reads 1 and 2 as its two args

size commands have no structural effect
a script takes only the next single token
\frac takes the tokens 1 and 2; the 3 follows as an ordinary atom
the mandatory arg of \sqrt is a single token after the optional arg
x^ab is x^{a} followed by b
3 is outside the denominator in a
a has sub i and sup 2; b has only a subscript i^2
cube root of x vs square root of 3x
the superscript binds to x only, not to -x
the superscript attaches to x in a, to the parenthesis group in b
e^-x is e^{-} followed by x
y is outside the radical in a
\int_0^2\pi has upper limit 2 and then \pi as an atom
the accent covers ab vs only a
the font scope covers ab vs only a
nested superscript vs a superscript on the group x^2
binomial vs fraction are distinct constructs
\frac is missing its second argument at end of input
\sqrt is missing its argument at end of input
^ is missing its argument at end of input
